-- Value of the first key equal to name, or None when absent.
lookup(keys: List[str], values: List[str], name: str) -> str? =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  ex lookup(keys: ["a", "b"], values: ["1", "2"], name: "b") == "2"
  ex lookup(keys: ["a"], values: ["1"], name: "z") == None
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] == name
      return values[i]
  None

-- Overlay the given keys on the defaults mode=fast and level=3.
-- Returns mode, level, then the other keys in the order given.
settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  ex settings(keys: ["mode"], values: ["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
  ex settings(keys: ["level", "color"], values: ["5", "red"]) == ["fast", "5", "red"]
  let mode = lookup(keys: keys, values: values, name: "mode") else "fast"
  let level = lookup(keys: keys, values: values, name: "level") else "3"
  var out = [mode, level]
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    if keys[i] == "mode" or keys[i] == "level"
      continue
    out = out + [values[i].copy()]
  out

test_lookup() =
  assert lookup(keys: ["a", "b"], values: ["1", "2"], name: "b") == "2"
  assert lookup(keys: ["a"], values: ["1"], name: "z") == None

test_settings() =
  assert settings(keys: ["mode"], values: ["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
  assert settings(keys: ["level", "color"], values: ["5", "red"]) == ["fast", "5", "red"]
  assert settings(keys: [], values: []) == ["fast", "3"]
